ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Data entry and initial assessment can go to a rules engine, but a person still has to investigate whether an income document is fraudulent.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reports that about 12,000 Credit Authorizers, Checkers, And Clerks were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 11,300 by 2034, a net loss of about 700 jobs, with roughly 1,000 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $49,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Credit Authorizers, Checkers, And Clerks, but it will reshape the approval process. Once data entry, credit-report matching, and initial scoring move to rules engines, clerks shift from keyboard work toward exception handling, fraud assessment, and compliance control. People who can detect fabrication and set consistent risk standards become genuinely scarce.
ai_s2_accel: Real-time fraud scoring
Intelligent routing of exceptions
Customer-profile-driven credit authorization
Automatic approval-status reminders
ai_s2_auto: Automatic entry of application information
Automatic matching of credit reports and income
Automated initial assessment by rules engines
Automatic recording of denials and audit trails
ai_s3_list: Fraud detection: people investigate false documents.
Exception handling: people decide cases outside the rules.
Compliance judgment: people safeguard whether a case can be approved.
Dispute coordination: people connect customers with managers.
Accountability: people answer for missed checks.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 score places this occupation in a moderate-high exposure area of approvals: rules and engines replace standardized credit decisions, while checking and exception handling still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. What is being replaced is standardized initial assessment, not the entire occupation. People skilled at detecting fraud and conducting fraud reviews become scarcer as automation routes routine cases away. Those who only enter data mechanically and do not learn new systems face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in finance and accounting, and master credit and credit-report knowledge while in school. Pure data-entry work is shrinking in the AI era, so start practicing fraud detection and judgment early.
Move from checking toward risk judgment. Learn fraud detection and rules, and work toward approval or risk-control roles instead of remaining in mechanical data entry.
Highlight attention to detail and checking experience, and specify the exceptions you have handled. Consumer-finance and credit-reporting experience is an advantage.
Hire for compliance and fraud-detection ability, not only entry speed. Clerks who can handle exceptions independently and accept accountability merit higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Rules engines and automated approval continue to divert standardized credit decisions.
Fraud detection and exception handling rely more heavily on people.
Versatile clerks who understand both checking and risk control are in greater demand.

body: Credit Authorizers, Checkers, And Clerks receive and review credit applications, verify applicants' identities, income, and credit information, and use authorization policies and rules engines to approve, deny, or refer applications.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 录入和初评能交给规则引擎，但「这份收入证明是不是假的」，还得人查。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年信贷授权员、核查员、文员在岗约 1.20 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.13 万人，岗位净减约 0.07 万个，年均产生约 0.10 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.91 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代信贷授权与核查文员，但会重做审批流程。信息录入、征信比对、初评分交给规则引擎后，文员从「敲键盘」挪向「例外处置、反欺诈判断与合规把关」。真正稀缺的是能甄别造假、定风险口径的人。
ai_s2_accel: 反欺诈的实时评分
例外的智能分派
客户画像驱动授信
审批进度的自动提醒
ai_s2_auto: 申请信息的自动录入
征信与收入自动比对
规则引擎的自动初评
拒件与轨迹的自动记录
ai_s3_list: 造假甄别：假证明靠人查。
例外处置：超规则靠人定。
合规判断：可不可批靠人守。
争议协调：客户与经理串起来。
责任兜底：漏核要人担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的审批区——标准化授信被规则和引擎替代，但核查与处置还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准化初评」，不是「岗位」。会甄别造假、能做反欺诈的人，反而随自动分流变得更稀缺。怕的是只做机械录入、不学新系统的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 金融会计打底，在校把信贷和征信知识学通。AI 时代纯录入在缩，早点练反欺诈和判断。
从「核查」升级成「风控判断」，学反欺诈和规则，争取转审批或风控，别停留在机械录数。
突出细心和核查经验，写清处理过哪些例外。有消金和征信经验优先。
招人看合规和反欺诈，不止看录入速度。能独立处置例外、敢担责的文员值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 规则引擎与自动审批持续分流标准化授信。
反欺诈与例外处置更重人。
会核查懂风控的复合文员更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate duties in seconds, but classification disputes and penalty responses still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 418,000 Customs Brokers employed in 2024, projected to rise to 430,300 by 2034. That is a net gain of about 12,300 jobs, with about 33,300 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $78,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: The direct answer: AI will not replace Customs Brokers, but it will take over rules-based work such as initial code screening, document entry, and duty calculation. The durable value lies in classification-dispute judgment, compliance strategy, and professional accountability. When customs holds a client's shipment, the client calls a person, not software.
ai_s2_accel: Classification review: AI compares past cases and flags possible classification errors
Policy tracking: automatic alerts for regulatory and tariff-rate changes
Inspection-document preparation: AI drafts initial explanatory materials
End-to-end data integration: single-window and customs declaration systems connect directly
ai_s2_auto: Initial HS code screening: AI recommends candidate tariff codes from product descriptions
Document entry and verification: OCR reads invoices and bills of lading and fills forms automatically
Duty and tax calculation: tariff rules calculate amounts due automatically
Initial compliance-risk screening: systems flag declaration elements automatically
ai_s3_list: Classification-dispute judgment. Borderline products, such as whether an item is a component or a complete machine, require integrated judgment; AI can only suggest candidates.
Penalty and exception response. How you explain and correct a questioned or inspected declaration directly affects the client's money.
Client trust and service. Clients place a vital link in their supply chain in your hands, relying on a long record of credibility.
Compliance strategy and planning. Designing approaches around lawful duty reduction and free trade agreements requires a whole-system view.
On-site communication and coordination. Systems cannot replace real-time coordination with customs, terminals, and freight forwarders.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: The logic behind the 5/10 score: about half of customs brokerage is rules-based work, including coding, entry, and duty calculation, which AI learns quickly. The other half involves dispute judgment and professional accountability, which resist standardization. This produces moderate exposure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high risk. The clearer the rule, the more AI can do, making the remaining disputes and accountability more valuable. Brokers who use AI to process more shipments can double their income.

ai_s5_persona.advice: International trade, customs declaration, and international freight remain worthwhile fields of study. Focus on classification logic and regulatory understanding instead of memorizing codes.
Use AI classification tools as review assistants. Build dispute-resolution and client-service skills to progress toward Senior Customs Specialist roles.
People with foreign trade or logistics backgrounds can transition quickly. Earn a customs-related credential and put handled classification disputes on your résumé.
Screen candidates for dispute-resolution skills and regulatory knowledge. Use AI tools for efficiency and keep experienced staff focused on difficult declarations.

ai_s6_tools.desc: HS code candidate recommendations and review
ai_s6_tools.name: AI classification assistant
General-purpose large language models such as ChatGPT and Claude

ai_s7_trends: Single-window and intelligent declaration systems spread, reducing human involvement in routine documentation
AI classification models keep improving, making classification disputes the central arena for brokers
Cross-border e-commerce and global supply-chain shifts create new customs needs, increasing scarcity of specialized brokers

body: Customs Brokers represent importers and exporters in customs clearance. They confirm product classifications and HS codes, calculate duties and taxes, prepare and submit declarations, ensure compliant clearance, and handle classification disputes and inspection coordination.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate duties in seconds, but classification disputes and penalty responses still require people.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能秒算关税，但归类争议和处罚应对还得找人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年海关经纪人在岗约 41.80 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 43.03 万人，净增约 1.23 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.33 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.84 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: 直接回答：AI 不会取代海关经纪人这个岗位，但会接管「编码初筛、单证录入、关税计算」这类规则化工作。真正被留下的价值是归类争议判断、合规策略和担责——客户被海关扣货时找的是人，不是软件。
ai_s2_accel: 归类复核：AI 对照历史案例提示归类偏差
政策追踪：法规与税率变动自动推送
查验资料准备：AI 辅助生成说明材料初稿
全链路数据对接：单一窗口与报关系统直连
ai_s2_auto: HS 编码初筛：AI 按商品描述自动推荐候选税则号
单证录入与核对：OCR 识别发票、提单自动填单
关税与税费计算：按税则自动核算到款
合规风险初筛：系统按申报要素自动打标提示
ai_s3_list: 归类争议判断。边界商品（比如某件货到底算零件还是整机）需要综合判断，AI 只能给候选。
处罚与异常应对。被查验、被质疑时怎么解释、怎么补正，关系到客户的真金白银。
客户信任与服务。客户把整条供应链的命脉交给你，靠的是长期信誉。
合规策略与规划。合理避税、自贸协定利用这些方案设计，需要整体视角。
现场沟通与协调。跟海关、码头、货代多方的临场沟通，系统替代不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 评分 5/10 的逻辑：报关一半是规则化工作（编码、录入、算税）——AI 上手快；另一半是争议判断和担责——没法标准化。所以是中高曝光分。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险。规则越清楚，AI 越能干，剩下的争议和担责反而更值钱。会用 AI 把单量做上去的经纪人，收入是翻倍的。

ai_s5_persona.advice: 国际贸易、报关与国际货运专业仍值得读，但要把重点放在归类逻辑和法规理解上，而不是死记编码。
把 AI 归类工具当复核助手用，重点练争议处理和客户服务，往资深关务专家走。
有外贸、物流背景的人切入快。考个关务相关资质，把「处理过归类争议」写进简历。
筛人看争议处理能力和法规功底，配 AI 工具提效，把骨干留在疑难单上。

ai_s7_trends: 单一窗口与智能申报普及，普通单证人工介入越来越少
AI 归类模型持续进步，归类争议成为经纪人的核心战场
跨境电商与全球供应链变化催生新关务需求，专业经纪人更稀缺

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can absorb much of the repetitive, structurable work of Data Entry Keyers, but judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination still rest with people. What actually gets squeezed out is pure execution.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 141,600 Data Entry Keyers were employed in 2024, declining to a projected 104,900 by 2034. That represents about 36,700 fewer jobs, with roughly 9,500 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $39,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not eliminate Data Entry Keyers, but it will reshape their workflow. Tools take repetitive, structured tasks, while people focus on judgment, accountability, and improvement. Scripted execution faces the greatest pressure; workers who understand real operating contexts and make decisions become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use data profiles to accelerate customer or learner assessment in data-entry workflows.
Use simulation and scenario tools to test data-entry plans faster.
Use retrieval tools to verify data-entry references and regulations.
Use collaboration tools to accelerate coordination across teams.
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate structured documents and reports for Data Entry Keyers.
Process and classify repetitive data handled by Data Entry Keyers.
Apply rule-based initial screening and scheduling to data-entry work.
Search knowledge bases and extract key points for Data Entry Keyers.
ai_s3_list: Professional judgment and tradeoffs in real data-entry settings.
Explain data-entry requirements to people outside the field.
Accountability and final review in data-entry work.
Coordinate people and resources across data-entry boundaries.
Reuse tacit knowledge built through long data-entry experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: Scoring rationale: AI can assist Data Entry Keyers, but professional judgment and accountable final review remain harder to replace. Exposure is 8/10, relatively high.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Turn 8/10 into an advantage: let AI take the repetitive work, and spend your time on real projects, judgment, and people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a solid foundation in data-entry methods and gain experience on real projects.
Connect your existing experience to data-entry work and identify a differentiated entry point.
Turn data-entry experience into standardized products or management practices to increase its leverage.
Use AI to remove repetitive data-entry work and focus on decisions.

ai_s7_trends: AI collaboration becomes standard for Data Entry Keyers, making tool fluency a baseline requirement.
High-value judgment and accountability become scarcer in data-entry work.
Data-entry roles evolve toward combinations of professional work + management or product ownership.

body: Data Entry Keyers enter information from paper or electronic records into systems quickly and accurately, serving as the first quality checkpoint in the data chain.

用模拟与沙盘加速Data Entry Keyers的方案推演。

基于规则的Data Entry Keyers初步筛查与排程。

把Data Entry Keyers专业知识讲给外行听的表达力。
Data Entry Keyers领域的责任承担与终审。
跨边界的Data Entry Keyers资源整合与人际协调。
Data Entry Keyers长期经验的隐性知识复用。

把Data Entry Keyers经验产品化/管理化，放大杠杆。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can chart drilling data, but only the operator holding the controls knows what the bit has struck underground.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 18,300 Earth Drillers, Except Oil And Gas were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 18,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 500 jobs, with about 1,700 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $59,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Earth Drillers, Except Oil And Gas, but it will change how crews understand subsurface conditions. Automatic records and real-time data transfer simplify logging. Operators still control the rig, judge drilling fluid by feel, and respond to stuck pipe. Most work happens in the field; AI reaches the data, not the drill floor.
ai_s2_accel: Measurement-while-drilling instruments transmit depth, speed, and pressure data in real time
Formation-recognition algorithms flag strata changes from drilling curves
Online drilling-fluid tests enable faster mixture adjustments
Drones and imagery assist site surveys and relocation planning
ai_s2_auto: Automatic recording of drilling parameters and one-click borehole logs
Digital positioning of borehole coordinates and well-site layout
Automatic equipment data collection and alerts
Digital numbering and records for core and soil samples
ai_s3_list: Judging field conditions: collapse, stuck pipe, and broken rods require immediate response based on sound and feel.
Equipment response: crews must repair drilling-tool failures on site instead of waiting for the manufacturer.
Safety limits and emergency plans: well sites carry many risks, and people enforce rules and anticipate hazards.
Coordination with geologists: operators explain actual subsurface conditions so logs remain reliable.
Physical and mental resilience: extended field work demands both.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in the low-moderate AI exposure range. Most work happens in the field, leaving few desk tasks for algorithms beyond records and data organization.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still brings change. Automatic logging and measurement while drilling are reaching worksites. Drillers who understand instruments and data will be more valuable than workers who rely only on physical effort. Manual drilling without proper records faces the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study drilling or engineering at a vocational school and seek field placements. Young drillers who interpret measurement-while-drilling data and maintain smart rigs are in demand, so accept a difficult start.

Master automatic logging and measurement-while-drilling instruments, and learn basic geotechnical engineering. Combine drilling with data interpretation to gain bargaining power in geothermal and environmental work.

Do not write only that you can operate a rig. State that you can read borehole logs, describe stuck-pipe or collapse incidents you resolved, and report monthly drilling footage. Certificates help, and dependable workers are welcome.
Do not hire for strength alone. Assess safety habits and data awareness. Drillers who independently lead a rig, produce compliant logs, and use basic instruments merit higher rig-day rates.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic storage of depth, speed, and pressure
Live drilling data and abnormal-condition alerts

ai_s7_trends: Measurement while drilling and automatic logging are becoming standard, making data-driven crews more competitive.
Demand is growing for geothermal, environmental-monitoring, and underground-space drilling beyond oil and gas.
Skilled driller shortages are worsening, creating a premium for workers who operate smart rigs and interpret data.

body: Earth Drillers operate rigs in soil and rock to create water wells, geothermal wells, geological exploration holes, and environmental-monitoring holes. They set up equipment, drill and sample, stabilize and flush holes, and maintain records that bring subsurface information to the surface.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can chart drilling data, but only the operator holding the controls knows what the bit has struck underground.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把钻进数据画成曲线，但钻头在地下碰到什么，只有握着操作杆的人知道。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年土方钻探工、石油天然气在岗约 1.83 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.88 万人，净增约 0.05 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.17 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.96 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代土方钻探工，但会改变「怎么知道地下情况」的方式。自动记录、实时数据回传让编录更省事，但钻机的方向盘、泥浆的手感、卡钻的现场判断，依然牢牢在操作工手里。这行八成时间在野外，AI 进得来的是数据端，进不来的是钻台上。
ai_s2_accel: 随钻监测仪器实时回传深度、转速、压力数据辅助判断
岩层识别算法根据钻进曲线提示地层变化
泥浆参数在线检测，配比调整更及时
无人机与影像辅助井场踏勘与转场规划
ai_s2_auto: 钻进参数自动记录，钻孔日志一键生成
定位打孔坐标与井位放样的数字化
设备运行数据的自动采集与告警
岩芯、土样编号与台账的电子化
ai_s3_list: 现场工况判断：塌孔、卡钻、断杆，凭声音和手感第一时间反应。
设备处置能力：钻具故障现场抢修，不能干等厂家。
安全底线与应急预案：井场风险多，规矩和预判靠人。
与地质人员的配合：把地下的真实情况讲清楚，编录靠谱。
吃苦与抗压：野外长期作业的体力与心理韧性。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业大部分时间在野外现场，能被算法标准化的桌面动作有限——主要就是记录和数据整理这些边角活。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于零变化：自动编录和随钻监测已经在进场，未来「会看数据、懂仪器」的钻工会比纯体力工吃香。真正被挤压的是只会闷头打孔、不做记录的老做法。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走中职/技校的钻探或工程类专业，多跟工地实习。AI 时代，会看随钻数据、会保养智能钻机的年轻钻工缺口大，别怕起步苦。
把自动编录、随钻监测这些新仪器玩熟，学点岩土工程常识。从「闷头打孔」升级成「打孔 + 读数据」，转地热、环保钻孔时议价力更强。
别只写「会开钻机」，写明你会看钻孔日志、处理过什么卡钻塌孔、一个月打多少进尺。有证优先，体力活方向欢迎踏实人。
招人别只看力气，要看安全习惯和数据意识。能独立带机、会做规范编录、懂基本仪器操作的钻工，值得给更高台班费。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 深度、转速、压力自动入档
随钻数据回传、异常提示

ai_s7_trends: 随钻监测与自动编录成为标配，数据化的钻探队伍更有竞争力。
地热、环保监测、地下空间勘探需求上升，非油气钻探场景扩容。
熟练钻工短缺加剧，会操作智能钻机、能读数据的复合型钻工溢价明显。

body: 土方钻探工负责操作钻机在土石地层中钻凿水井、地热井、地质勘探孔与环保监测孔，包括设备架设、钻进取样、护壁与冲洗、记录编录，是把「地下的情况」带到地面的关键工。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把钻进数据画成曲线，但钻头在地下碰到什么，只有握着操作杆的人知道。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can compare operating logs with discharge data, but inspectors still decide which leads justify a case, how to collect evidence on site, and what enforcement action is appropriate.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 418,000 Environmental Compliance Inspectors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 430,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 12,300 jobs, with about 33,300 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $78,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Environmental Compliance Inspectors, but it will accelerate routine reviews. Online monitoring, AI-assisted record checks, and remote sensing reduce repetitive inspection work. Inspectors shift from collecting figures toward site judgment, evidence gathering, enforcement decisions, and remediation follow-up. Data-entry-only assistants face pressure, while inspectors with field and enforcement skills become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Calculate total emissions intelligently
Send remediation deadline reminders
Build risk profiles for regulated companies
Connect and analyze data from multiple sources
ai_s2_auto: Generate automatic alerts from online monitoring
Compare operating records automatically
Use remote sensing to identify suspected discharge outlets
Generate inspection records automatically
ai_s3_list: Site judgment: people determine whether anomalies matter.
Evidence and case initiation: people investigate the leads.
Enforcement discretion: people set the appropriate response.
Remediation oversight: people ensure the case reaches closure.
Company coordination: people manage the communication.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates moderate-high exposure. Systems accelerate data and record reviews, but site inspections and enforcement discretion remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high job risk. Automation replaces routine entry and comparison tasks, not field enforcement. Inspectors with strong evidence-gathering and enforcement judgment become scarcer as tools improve. Data-entry-only assistants face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through an environmental science or chemical engineering bachelor's degree. Gain experience with monitoring and regulations during university. Pure data-entry work is contracting, so develop field inspection and enforcement skills early.
Move beyond checking figures toward risk assessment and enforcement. Learn online monitoring systems and AI tools, then seek responsibility for a geographic area.
Highlight field inspection and remediation experience. Specify the types of regulated companies you worked with. Regulatory employers value steady judgment and firm follow-through.
Do not screen candidates by education alone. Evaluate their judgment on site. Inspectors who can initiate cases and drive remediation deserve priority for established roles.

ai_s7_trends: Online monitoring and remote sensing improve efficiency, reducing routine inspections.
Carbon-reduction regulation creates long-term opportunities.
Inspectors with field enforcement skills are in greater demand.

body: Environmental Compliance Inspectors lead environmental compliance inspections of pollution sources and construction projects. They oversee discharge outlets, hazardous waste, and records, issue inspection findings, and track remediation through closure.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can compare operating logs with discharge data, but inspectors still decide which leads justify a case, how to collect evidence on site, and what enforcement action is appropriate.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动比对台账和排口数据，但哪条线索要立案、现场怎么取证、裁量怎么定，还是检查员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年环境合规检查员在岗约 41.80 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 43.03 万人，净增约 1.23 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.33 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.84 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代环境合规检查员，但会加速常规核查。在线监测、AI 台账比对和遥感把重复巡检提速，检查员从「跑腿查数」挪向「现场判断、取证立案、执法裁量、整改督办」。真正被挤掉的是只做数据录入的助理，有现场力能执法的更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 排放总量智能核算
整改时限提醒
风险企业智能画像
多源数据关联分析
ai_s2_auto: 在线监测自动预警
台账数据自动比对
遥感排查疑似排口
监察记录自动生成
ai_s3_list: 现场判断：疑点靠人定。
取证立案：线索靠人挖。
执法裁量：尺度靠人握。
整改督办：闭环靠人盯。
企业协调：沟通靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的监察区——数据与台账被系统加速，但现场与裁量还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「常规录入与比对」动作，不是「现场执法」的岗位。有取证力和裁量力的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做数据录入的助理。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 环境/化工本科打底，在校多摸监测和法规。AI 时代纯录入在缩，早点练现场和执法。
从「查数」升级成「做研判 + 抓执法」，学在线监测和 AI 工具，争取负责片区。
突出现场和整改经验，写清跟过哪些类型企业。监管单位看重稳和硬。
选人别只看学历，要看有没有现场脑子。能立案督办的骨干，值得给编制倾斜。

ai_s7_trends: 在线与遥感提效，常规巡检缩。
双碳监管带来长期机会。
有现场执法力的人更抢手。

body: 环境合规检查员主导污染源与建设项目的环保合规监察，统筹排口、危废与台账，运用监测与核查手段，出具监察记录并跟进整改闭环。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动比对台账和排口数据，但哪条线索要立案、现场怎么取证、裁量怎么定，还是检查员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can see an entire forest on a screen, but only people on the ground understand its tracks, mud, and shifting wind.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 10,800 Forest And Conservation Workers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 10,300 by 2034, a net loss of about 500 jobs, with roughly 2,000 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $43,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Forest And Conservation Workers, but it will change patrol methods. Satellite images, drones, and AI identification now handle parts of forest observation. Screens can reveal pests, fires, and sample-plot patterns. People still fight fires, measure remote plots, and work with local communities.
ai_s2_accel: Remote sensing and AI identify pests and map affected areas
Satellite wildfire detection and meter-level location alerts
Automated drone patrols with night vision and thermal imaging
AI species identification from audio and images for wildlife monitoring
ai_s2_auto: Electronic sample-plot data collection through tablets and phones
Routine satellite and drone inspections replacing some visual patrols
Automated GIS mapping and data organization
Automated patrol records and report drafts
ai_s3_list: Field endurance and adaptation: workers cross mountains and ravines where machines cannot operate.
Wildfire response: wind, terrain, and fire behavior require immediate decisions measured in minutes.
Work in difficult terrain: people must reach plots near cliffs and monitoring sites in wetlands.
Community communication: conservation outreach, dispute resolution, and trust depend on people.
Integrated ecological judgment: long field experience turns static data into a living assessment of forest conditions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means about half of the occupation's tasks are moving to screens. AI already handles parts of image analysis, sample-plot statistics, and wildfire detection.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high risk. Wider AI coverage creates more need for people to verify conditions and act in the field. Roles limited to walking patrols face pressure, while frontline workers with remote-sensing and drone skills are scarce.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study forestry, ecology, or forestry technology, and learn GIS, remote sensing, and drone operation. The work offers stability and ecological value, but realistic pay expectations matter.

Move beyond traditional mountain patrols. Learn drone operations, remote-sensing data processing, and AI identification tools. Combining data verification with field response creates stronger advancement options.

Physical fitness is a firm requirement, so confirm that you can sustain long field assignments. A drone-pilot or forestry credential can fill technical gaps. Show field resilience and data-collection experience in applications.

Do not hire by education alone. Assess field endurance and learning ability. Frontline workers who fly drones and interpret remote-sensing images are harder to find than workers limited to physical patrols.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Forest imagery, night vision, and thermal reconnaissance
Forest-cover change, wildfire alerts, and pest-area mapping
Sample-plot mapping, patrol-route planning, and data analysis
Photo-based identification of diseases and pests for field assessment
Real-time fire location and response-resource dispatch
Automated species identification and activity-pattern statistics
Positioning, networked communication, and SOS service outside cellular coverage
Offline entry, photographic evidence, and one-touch reporting

ai_s7_trends: Remote sensing and AI are becoming standard for forest monitoring. Drone patrols are routine, and workers focus on verifying priority areas.
Fire-prevention systems are becoming more intelligent. Satellites detect fires, systems send alerts, and people respond on the ground.
Frontline roles are gaining technical requirements. Field workers who operate drones and understand remote-sensing data are scarce, while purely physical patrol roles are shrinking.

body: Forest And Conservation Workers carry out reforestation, stand improvement, fire prevention, pest control, sample-plot surveys, and patrols at state-owned forest farms, protected areas, and forestry projects. They turn forestry research and management plans into field action.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can see an entire forest on a screen, but only people on the ground understand its tracks, mud, and shifting wind.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能在屏幕上看见整片森林，但林子里的脚印、泥泞和风向，只有在地面上的人才懂。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年森林与自然保护从业人员在岗约 1.08 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.03 万人，岗位净减约 0.05 万个，年均产生约 0.20 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.37 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代森林与自然保护从业人员，但会改变巡护方式。卫星影像、无人机和 AI 识别正在接管「看林子」这件事——病虫害识别、火点监测、样地分析都能在屏幕上完成。但山火现场的扑救、偏远样地的实测、跟村民打交道，这些还得靠人。
ai_s2_accel: 遥感 + AI 识别病虫害，发病范围自动圈定
卫星火点监测与预警，火情定位到米
无人机自动巡林，夜视/热成像辅助
AI 物种识别（声纹/图像）辅助野生动物监测
ai_s2_auto: 样地数据电子化采集，平板/手机直接录入
卫星与无人机影像的常规巡检替代人工巡看
GIS 制图与数据整理自动化
巡护记录与报告初稿自动生成
ai_s3_list: 野外体能与实地适应：翻山越岭、爬坡过沟，机器进不了的地方就是主战场。
火情现场处置：风向、地形、火势的即时判断，扑救决策按分钟算。
复杂地形的操作：悬崖边的样地、沼泽里的监测点，只能人去。
与当地社区的沟通：护林宣传、纠纷协调、村民信任，靠的是人。
生态综合判断：数据是死的，林子是活的，综合评估需要长期蹲守的直觉。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半任务正在被屏幕化——影像分析、样地统计、火点监测，AI 已经接管了不少。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：AI 看得越远，越需要有人去现场核实、去处置、去落地。真正被压缩的是「单纯靠腿跑巡护」的岗位，懂遥感、会操作无人机的一线人才反而更缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读林学、生态学、林业技术相关专业，在校把 GIS、遥感、无人机操作学起来。这个方向工作稳定、环境单纯，但收入预期要摆正，更多是「生态价值」而非「高薪」。
别只守着「巡山护林」的传统活法，把无人机巡林、遥感数据处理和 AI 识别工具学起来。从「执行者」升级为「数据核验 + 现场处置」复合型人才，晋升空间更大。
身体素质是硬门槛，先确认自己能适应长期野外作业。可以考无人机飞手或林业相关证书补技术短板，求职时多展示你在野外的韧性和数据采集能力。
招人别只看学历，要看野外耐受力和学习能力。能力模型要加上数字化工具——会飞无人机、能看懂遥感影像的一线人员，比纯体力型巡护员更稀缺。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 林区影像采集、夜视/热成像侦察
森林覆盖变化、火点预警、病虫害范围圈定
样地制图、巡护路径规划、数据分析
拍照识别病害虫种，辅助判断
实时火点定位、扑救资源调度
自动识别物种，统计活动规律
无信号区定位、组网通信、SOS
离线录入、拍照留证、一键上报

ai_s7_trends: 遥感 + AI 成为林区监测标配，无人机巡林常态化，人工巡护转向重点核验。
防火体系智能化，火情从「发现靠人喊」变成「卫星盯、系统报、人处置」。
一线岗位升级：会操作无人机、懂遥感数据的野外人才缺口明显，纯体力巡护岗收缩。

body: 森林与自然保护从业人员在国有林场、保护区和林业工程一线执行造林抚育、防火、病虫害防治、样地调查与巡护任务，是林业科研和管理规划的「落地执行者」。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能在屏幕上看见整片森林，但林子里的脚印、泥泞和风向，只有在地面上的人才懂。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can annotate variants in minutes and review hundreds of papers, but scientists still decide whether a mutation is pathogenic and which experiment to run next.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 63,700 workers in 2024, projected to rise to 64,500 by 2034. That is a net gain of about 800 jobs, with roughly 4,800 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $93,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Geneticists, but it will reshape research. AI accelerates variant annotation, sequence alignment, and literature review, shifting scientists toward experimental design, research direction, and result interpretation. Asking the right question and judging the evidence remain scientific responsibilities.
ai_s2_accel: Large language models assist scientific literature interpretation
AI predicts protein structures and variant effects
Intelligent single-cell and multi-omics analysis
Automated assistance for gene-editing design
ai_s2_auto: Automatic variant annotation and pathogenicity scoring
Automated sequence alignment and assembly
AI-assisted literature search and review
Sequencing quality control and report generation
ai_s3_list: Research direction: deciding which question deserves investigation matters more than routine execution.
Experimental design: controls, sample size, and validation paths require scientific judgment.
Clinical interpretation: links between variants and disease must be judged in patient context.
Scientific ethics: people remain responsible for genetic privacy and ethical safeguards.
Cross-disciplinary integration: scientists combine experiments, statistics, and clinical evidence into conclusions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score places this occupation in a moderate AI exposure range. AI is taking over more annotation, alignment, and literature analysis.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high replacement risk. AI handles more computation, leaving question formation and result interpretation to scientists. Pure pipeline roles face pressure, while Geneticists who design experiments, interpret clinical evidence, and use AI effectively gain value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build foundations in both biology and statistics, then specialize in genetics or bioinformatics during graduate study. Biology without mathematics and programming creates a disadvantage.

Use AI variant annotation and literature tools, and learn single-cell and multi-omics analysis. Grow from wet-lab execution and analysis into a scientist who combines AI, experimental design, and interpretation.

Bioinformatics backgrounds transfer naturally into genetic analysis. Genetic counseling or clinical genetics support can also provide an entry path. Show pipelines, variant interpretation projects, and clinical collaborations on your resume.
Do not hire Geneticists on publications alone. Assess AI tool use and experimental design. Scientists who accelerate work with AI while maintaining clinical judgment are scarce.

ai_s6_tools.工具: Protein prediction tools such as AlphaFold

ai_s7_trends: AI now plays a major role in variant annotation and literature research. Geneticists are shifting from manual analysis toward experimental design, scientific direction, and clinical interpretation.
Precision medicine and gene therapy are increasing demand for clinical Geneticists and bioinformatics scientists, especially people who cross disciplines.
Rapid growth in genetic data makes data governance, ethics, and compliance more important. Scientists who combine computation, clinical knowledge, and ethical judgment remain scarce.

body: Geneticists study gene structure, function, inheritance, and variation through genome analysis, disease research, and variant interpretation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can annotate variants in minutes and review hundreds of papers, but scientists still decide whether a mutation is pathogenic and which experiment to run next.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能几分钟注释完变异、帮你读几百篇文献，但「这个突变到底致不致病、下个实验该怎么做」——方向的判断，还得靠你的脑子。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年遗传学家在岗约 6.37 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.45 万人，净增约 0.08 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.48 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.33 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代遗传学家，但会重构科研方式。变异注释、序列比对、文献综述正被 AI 深度加速，遗传学家从「动手分析」转向「设计实验、判断方向、解读结果」。研究的价值在于提出问题和判断问题，这是 AI 替代不了的——会用 AI 的遗传学家效率翻倍，不会用的会被拉开差距。
ai_s2_accel: 大模型辅助解读科研文献
AI 预测蛋白结构与变异影响
单细胞与多组学智能分析
基因编辑设计自动化辅助
ai_s2_auto: 变异自动注释与致病性打分
序列比对与拼接自动化
文献检索与综述 AI 辅助
测序质控与报告生成
ai_s3_list: 研究方向的判断：什么问题值得做，比怎么做的价值更大。
实验设计的功底：对照、样本量、验证路径，AI 给不了。
临床解读的分寸：突变与疾病的关系，要结合病例判断。
科学伦理的责任：基因数据涉及隐私与伦理，靠人把关。
跨学科整合：实验、统计、临床，把知识拧成判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业的数据分析和文献环节正在被 AI 深度接管——注释、比对、综述，AI 都能帮上大忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接管的是「计算与分析」环节，留下的是「提出问题和判断结果」的环节。纯数据管道工式的岗位会被压缩，能设计实验、会临床解读、善用 AI 的遗传学家反而更抢手。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 本科打生物和统计双基础，读研再专攻遗传学或生物信息。别只报纯生物，数学编程跟不上会吃亏。
把 AI 变异注释、大模型文献工具用起来，主动学单细胞和多组学分析。从「湿实验+分析」升级为「AI+设计+解读」复合科学家。
生信背景转遗传分析最顺，或从遗传咨询师、临床遗传助理切入。简历上多写「会哪些分析管线、做过什么变异解读、有没有临床合作」。
招遗传学家别只看论文，要看 AI 工具使用和实验设计能力。能善用 AI 提速、又有临床判断的科学家，是稀缺人才。

ai_s7_trends: AI 深度介入变异注释与文献研究，遗传学家从「动手分析」转向「设计实验、判断方向、临床解读」，AI 素养成为核心技能。
精准医疗与基因治疗兴起，临床遗传学家与生物信息科学家需求持续增长，跨界人才更抢手。
基因数据规模爆发，数据管理与伦理合规成为课题，懂计算、懂临床、守伦理的复合科学家更稀缺。

body: 遗传学家研究基因的结构、功能、遗传与变异规律，开展基因组测序分析、遗传疾病研究与变异解读，并为医学诊断、药物研发和农业育种提供科学依据。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能几分钟注释完变异、帮你读几百篇文献，但「这个突变到底致不致病、下个实验该怎么做」——方向的判断，还得靠你的脑子。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate the production schedule accurately to every second, but "should this line be shut down tonight" still needs to be decided by the manager.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that there will be approximately 241,900 industrial production managers on the job in 2024, and the number is expected to rise to 246,500 by 2034, with a net increase of approximately 4,600 positions, an average annual vacancy of approximately 17,100, and a median annual salary of approximately US$121,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace industrial production managers, but it will upgrade management. After production scheduling, reports and exception warnings are handed over to AI, managers move from "scheduling" to "making on-site decisions, managing people, and coordinating across departments." What is truly scarce are people who can deliver in chaos and lead a team.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted dynamic production scheduling and rescheduling
Intelligent prediction of quality defects
Recommendations for matching personnel and equipment
Real-time optimization of costs and energy consumption
ai_s2_auto: Automatic optimization of production scheduling and capacity
Automatic generation of production yield reports
Automatic early warning of abnormalities and equipment alarms
Automatic accounting of materials and inventory
ai_s3_list: On-site decision-making: How to rescue when an abnormality occurs.
People management: able to lead the team.
Cross-department coordination: Alignment of production, marketing and supply.
Safety Responsibility: Don’t step on the red line.
Priority judgment: How to arrange urgent orders.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 shows that this profession is in the production data area with medium and high exposure - production scheduling, reports, and early warnings can all be accelerated, but decision-making and management are still left to humans.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: But medium and high exposure does not mean high risk: what is replaced is "calculation and retribution", not "management and decision-making". Production managers who can make on-site decisions and lead a team are even rarer. What I'm afraid of are the data clerks who only do tables.

ai_s5_persona.建议: With a background in engineering management, I studied supply chain and digitalization in school. In the AI ​​era, work on-site and lead people, don’t just be a clerk.
Be familiar with MES and production scheduling tools, and improve personnel management. Upgraded from "Pipeline Production Line" to "Pipeline Factory" and transferred to factory director.
Highlight how much scale you have managed and how much yield you have improved. Priority will be given to on-site and team results.
Recruitment depends on on-site decision-making and leadership, not just academic qualifications. Managers who can save delivery deserve a good salary.

ai_s7_trends: Smart manufacturing makes production management more digital.
APS and MES are popularized, and scheduling positions are compressed.
Factory directors who are capable of on-site and digital work are even rarer.

body: Industrial production managers formulate production plans and schedules, manage quality, cost, safety and personnel, and coordinate manufacturing resources to ensure that products are delivered on time and with high quality. They are the core managers of factory operations.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把排产算成分秒不差，但「这条线今晚要不要为人停机」，还得经理拍板。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代工业生产经理，但会升级管理。排产、报表和异常预警交给 AI 后，经理从「排表」挪向「做现场决策、管人和跨部门协调」。真正稀缺的是能在混乱里救交付、带得动团队的人。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助动态排产重调度
质量缺陷的智能预判
人员与设备的匹配推荐
成本与能耗的实时优化
ai_s2_auto: 生产排产与产能的自动优化
产量良率报表的自动生成
异常与设备报警的自动预警
物料与库存的自动核算
ai_s3_list: 现场决策：异常时怎么救。
人员管理：带得动团队。
跨部门协调：产销供对齐。
安全责任：红线不踩。
优先级判断：急单怎么排。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的生产数据区——排产、报表、预警都能被加速，但决策和管理仍留给人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「算和报」，不是「管和决」。会现场决策、能带团队的生产经理更稀缺。怕的是只做排表的数据员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 工科管理打底，在校多学供应链与数字化。AI 时代拼现场与带人，别只当文员。
把 MES 和排产工具用熟，补人员管理。从「管产线」升级成「管工厂」，转厂长。
突出你管过多大规模、提过多少良率。有现场和团队成果优先。
招人看现场决策和带人，不止看学历。能救交付的经理值得高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 智能制造让生产管理更数据化。
APS 与 MES 普及，排表岗压缩。
会现场与数字化的厂长更稀缺。

body: 工业生产经理制定生产计划与排产，管理质量、成本、安全与人员，统筹制造资源保障产品按时按质交付，是工厂运营的核心管理者。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can produce a case-law review in ten seconds, but law faculty must still guide students through judgments page by page to ask whether a decision is justified and which legal principles conflict beneath it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 29,500 postsecondary law teachers employed in 2024, projected to reach 30,200 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 700 jobs, with roughly 2,200 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $126,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI is penetrating nearly every part of postsecondary law teaching without replacing its core. Legal research, case synthesis, course-material organization, and initial drafting all become much faster, while student work carries increasing signs of AI use. This pushes faculty from transmitting knowledge toward training judgment: teaching students to detect AI errors, question legal premises, and reason where machines cannot. In research, AI can search and draft, but people still identify meaningful questions and make original contributions.
ai_s2_accel: AI case analysis assists classroom case selection
Intelligent learning platforms support large-course management
AI-assisted grading for standardized assignments
Rapid growth in interdisciplinary AI-law research
ai_s2_auto: Automatic legal research and case synthesis
Assisted generation of course notes, slides, and syllabi
Detection of AI signals in assignments and draft papers
Automatic organization of literature reviews and references
ai_s3_list: Legal judgment: build analytical frameworks in ambiguous areas beyond AI retrieval.
Critical teaching: teach students to identify and challenge AI-generated conclusions.
Academic originality: frame real questions, conduct genuine research, and make meaningful contributions.
Practice-based instruction: add human judgment to moot courts and legal writing.
Academic community: sustain judgment and trust in peer review and conferences.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 score reflects AI's extensive reach into knowledge production. Machines handle research, organization, and first drafts, while student AI use weakens traditional assessment. Yet legal education is fundamentally about training thought. AI replaces information work, not the ability to cultivate legal reasoning or frame important frontier questions, making strong faculty more valuable despite moderate-high exposure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean unemployment. Faculty who cannot use AI will fall behind, but those who use it without substantive expertise will also struggle. Future law teachers must either produce stronger research with AI assistance or become indispensable educators in reasoning and recognizing AI's limits.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Prepare for a long academic path, commonly through bachelor's, master's, and doctoral study. Begin publishing and building a record during the doctorate. Develop academic judgment as a core skill, while watching emerging intersections such as AI law and legal technology.

Use AI to accelerate research and course preparation, then invest the saved time in substantive questions. Reform assessment through open-book work, oral defense, and classroom argument to reduce AI ghostwriting. Interdisciplinary research and digital teaching also create new opportunities for promotion and grants.

Moving from legal practice or in-house counsel to academia is possible but highly competitive. Complete the doctoral credential and publication record before applying. Emphasize teaching ability, research output, and AI-enabled teaching innovation, because universities assess a different evidence set from legal employers.

Assessment systems must adapt to the AI era. Evaluate the ability to identify AI limits and use AI for teaching innovation while protecting review credibility from AI-written scholarship. Reasonable review cycles and research support retain early-career faculty better than continually increasing requirements.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Retrieve cases and statutes in seconds
Identify AI generation in assignments and papers
Manage and support interaction in large online courses
Automatically extract and compare classroom cases
Improve foreign-language research and bilingual writing

ai_s7_trends: AI becomes standard in legal teaching and research, shifting faculty from transmitting knowledge toward training thought.
AI law and legal technology become new growth areas in legal research and employment.
Assessment systems are rebuilt to address AI ghostwriting and evaluate AI-enabled teaching innovation.

body: Postsecondary law teachers teach and conduct legal research at colleges and universities, teaching courses, supervising undergraduate and graduate theses and practical training, publishing scholarship, and contributing to program development and academic administration.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能在十秒里把一份判例综述写出来，但「这个案子的判决到底有没有道理、背后的法理冲突是什么」，得靠法学教师带着学生一页页读判决书。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年高校法学教师在岗约 2.95 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.02 万人，净增约 0.07 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.22 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.66 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 对高校法学教师的影响是「全面渗透但替代不了核心」：法律检索、案例归纳、讲义整理甚至初稿写作都被 AI 大幅提速，学生的作业和论文也越来越多 AI 痕迹——这倒逼教师从「传授知识」转向「训练思维」：教学生识别 AI 的错、追问法理的前提、在机器给不出答案的地方建立判断。科研端，AI 能帮你检索文献、生成初稿，但「提出真问题、做出真贡献」永远是人的活。
ai_s2_accel: AI 判例分析辅助课堂教学案例选取
智能学习平台支撑大规模课程管理
AI 批改辅助标准化作业评分
交叉学科（人工智能法）研究快速兴起
ai_s2_auto: 法律检索与案例归纳自动生成
讲义、课件与教学大纲辅助生成
作业与论文初稿的 AI 痕迹检测
文献综述与参考文献自动整理
ai_s3_list: 法理判断：在 AI 检索不到的模糊地带建立分析框架。
批判性教学：教学生识别与质疑 AI 生成的结论。
学术原创：提出真问题、做真研究、产出真贡献。
实务训练指导：模拟法庭、法律文书的人性化打磨。
学术共同体：同行评审、学术会议的判断与信任。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业的知识生产环节被 AI 大幅渗透：检索、整理、初稿都能交给机器，学生的 AI 使用也让传统考核方式失效。但法学教育的本质是「思维训练」，AI 替代的是资料性劳动，替代不了把学生带进法律思维、在学术前沿提出真问题的能力——这正是中高曝光分数下，教师价值反而更突出的原因。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于失业：不会用 AI 的教师会被时代甩开，但只会用 AI、没有真学问的教师同样立不住。未来的法学教师，要么在 AI 辅助下产出更高质量的研究，要么在「训练思维、识别 AI 局限」上成为不可替代的教育者。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走学术路线要做好长线准备：本硕博一路读下来是常态，读博期间就要开始发论文、攒成果。把「学术品味」当核心能力培养，同时留意法学教育与 AI 结合的新方向（人工智能法、法律科技）。
把 AI 当科研和备课的加速器，省下的时间投入真问题。主动改革考核方式——开卷、答辩、课堂思辨都能防 AI 代写；同时向交叉学科和数字化教学转型，这是职称和课题的新增长点。
从律师、法务转高校是可行路径但竞争激烈：先补齐博士学历和论文成果再投教职。简历突出「教学能力 + 科研成果 + AI 教学创新」，别只讲实务经验，高校考核体系看的是另一套东西。
考核体系要跟上 AI 时代：把「识别和利用 AI 进行教学创新」纳入评价，别让 AI 代写论文冲垮评审公信。给青年教师合理的考核周期和科研支持，比一味加码更能留住人才。

法律概念与关系可视化

考核体系重构：防 AI 代写与 AI 教学创新进入评价维度。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Algorithms can build schedules, but they cannot answer what audiences want to watch tonight.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 167,000 Media Programming Directors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 175,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 8,200 jobs, with around 12,800 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $83,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Media Programming Directors, but it will replace purely manual scheduling. Algorithms now produce recommendations in minutes instead of relying on memorized ratings curves and hand-built grids. What remains is judgment about which genre will succeed and which program deserves an advertising slot. The field is shifting from experience alone to experience validated by data.
ai_s2_accel: Ratings prediction models support premieres
Automatic real-time ratings alerts and cause attribution
Trending-event content radar supports timely programming
A/B scheduling tests rapidly compare lineups
ai_s2_auto: Automatic schedule generation and conflict checking
Automatic aggregation and reporting of historical ratings
Basic allocation and placement of advertising slots
Program-library metadata and scheduling-ledger management
ai_s3_list: Content taste and prediction: machines cannot take a position on how genre, cast, and timing combine to affect audiences.
Commercial negotiation: acquisition pricing, advertising rates, and cross-department scheduling depend on relationships and persuasion.
Risk decisions: leaders personally bear the consequences of choosing breakout potential or protecting the baseline.
Emergency response: major incidents and public sentiment require schedule changes without templates.
Audience understanding: why people watch matters more than the data alone.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 means algorithms can handle most desk tasks, including schedules, ratings calculations, and reports, creating broad AI exposure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not equal high risk. Stronger tools make decision roles more valuable. Execution roles that copy old scheduling patterns face pressure, while programmers who combine AI forecasts with judgment can manage more channels and platforms.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study media, film, or data and intern in content operations at a broadcaster or platform. Upgrade from producing content to scheduling it and reading data to create broader options.
Use AI scheduling and ratings prediction to save time for judgment and commercial work. Operate across platforms because short drama, livestreaming, and streaming use transferable programming logic.

Do not list only schedule-building on a résumé. State which programs you scheduled, ratings gains, and added advertising revenue. Candidates who understand data and explain programming logic are in demand at platforms and MCNs.

Do not hire only from television. Operations thinking, data ability, and content taste are a rare combination. Programmers who use AI scheduling tools can manage more portfolios and deserve higher pay.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Generate weekly schedules and check conflicts in seconds
Aggregate online trends and suggest topics
Unified search for rights, schedules, and ratings

ai_s7_trends: Programming becomes fully data-driven, AI forecasts become standard, and roles shift from scheduling to judgment.
Programming across long-form video, short drama, and livestreaming integrates, with content operations replacing channel scheduling as the mainstream role.
Content producers and platforms increasingly overlap, making programming expertise valuable at production companies.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 排片表可以交给算法，但「今晚观众想看到什么」这道题，算法答不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年媒体节目编排总监在岗约 16.70 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 17.52 万人，净增约 0.82 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.28 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.35 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代媒体节目编排总监，但会取代「纯手工排片」。以前靠经验背收视曲线、靠人肉排表的工作，现在算法几分钟就能给出排期建议；真正留下来的是那些会下判断的人——判断哪个题材能爆、哪条广告位该让给哪档节目。这行正在从「经验驱动」转成「经验 + 数据验证」。
ai_s2_accel: 收视预测模型辅助新节目定档
实时收视异常自动预警与原因归因
热点事件内容雷达辅助应景编排
A/B 排播测试快速对比不同片单效果
ai_s2_auto: 排期表的自动生成与冲突检查
历史收视数据的自动汇总与报告
广告点位的基础分配与排布
节目库元数据与档期台账管理
ai_s3_list: 内容品味与预判：题材、阵容、档期叠加后观众买不买账，机器给不了立场。
商业谈判：购片压价、广告议价、跨部门抢档期，靠的是关系与话术。
风险决策：押爆款还是保基本盘，判断错了要自己担。
突发处置：重大事故与舆情下的换档决策，没有模板可抄。
对观众的理解：数据背后的「人为什么要看」，比数据本身重要。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这行的案头动作——排表、算收视、写报告——大部分都能被算法代劳，AI 接触面确实广。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：工具越强，「决策位」越值钱。被挤压的是只会照抄过往排片经验的执行岗；会用 AI 做预测、再用自己的判断拍板的编排人，反而能同时管更多频道和平台。

把 AI 排期和收视预测工具用起来，把时间省下来盯判断和商务。主动接多平台运营，短剧、直播、流媒体的编排逻辑相通，别把自己锁在单一频道。
简历别只写「排过班表」，要写「排了什么节目、收视涨了几个点、广告多卖了多少钱」。会看数据、能说清排播逻辑的候选人，平台和 MCN 都抢着要。
招编排别再只看电视台出身，运营思维 + 数据能力 + 内容品味三者齐的人更难找。给会使用 AI 排播工具的编排人更高薪资，他们同时能管更多盘子。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated lines can complete the process and AI can monitor solution concentration, but experienced workers still determine whether a dull batch results from current or chemistry and how to arrange racks for uniform plating.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 31,700 plating machine setters, operators, and tenders for metal and plastic were employed in 2024. By 2034, employment is projected to decline to 27,400, a net loss of about 4,300 jobs, with about 2,500 openings per year. The median annual salary is about $41,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and automation will not immediately replace plating equipment operators, but they will change the work. Fully automated plating lines, automatic chemical dosing, and AI concentration monitoring take over repetitive operations, shifting workers from manual racking and parameter adjustment toward bath preparation, quality judgment, and equipment maintenance. Coating-quality judgment and bath-preparation experience remain irreplaceable, making process-savvy technicians more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: AI solution-concentration monitoring system
Online coating inspection equipment
Robotic automatic racking
Digital-twin process optimization
ai_s2_auto: Automated loading and unloading on plating lines
Automatic chemical dosing and concentration control
Automatic current and time settings
Automated production-data records
ai_s3_list: Bath-preparation experience: people use judgment for solution proportions and additive volumes.
Coating-quality judgment: recognize causes of dullness, peeling, and pitting at a glance.
Rack arrangement technique: position parts for uniform coatings.
Adaptability during anomalies: resolve unstable current and contaminated baths on site.
Safety and environmental awareness: protection and waste-liquid handling cannot be reduced in a chemical workshop.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 indicates that automation is taking over some repetitive operations. Automated lines and systems support racking, parameter adjustment, and records.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does involve risk. Automation reduces pure operating roles, while bath preparation, quality judgment, and process adjustment still depend on people. People limited to racking and lowering parts into baths face the greatest concern; technicians who prepare baths and tune processes are more resilient.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study surface treatment, chemical engineering, or electromechanics and earn safety certificates. Strong environmental awareness is essential; avoid unlicensed small workshops.

Learn automated plating lines, AI concentration monitoring, and coating inspection while actively studying bath preparation and processes. Advance from operator to plating technician and earn process-related certificates.
A chemical or electromechanical background is ideal, with entry possible through racking or apprenticeships. On a resume, specify plating types, baths prepared, and quality problems resolved.

When hiring operators, assess chemical foundations and compliance, not willingness to endure hardship alone. Employees willing to learn bath processes and environmental practices deserve development into technical leaders.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automated loading and unloading for plating

ai_s7_trends: As fully automated plating lines and AI concentration monitoring spread, operators shift from manual racking and parameter adjustment toward bath processes, quality judgment, and equipment maintenance. Process capability becomes the core competitive advantage.
Stricter environmental policy eliminates outdated capacity and drives automation and consolidation, making technicians in high-end electronics and automotive plating more valuable.
Online coating inspection and digital twins are being implemented, shifting operators toward combined process + quality + environmental roles.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动线能自己走完流程、AI 能监控药水浓度，但「这批零件镀得发暗是电流问题还是药水问题」「挂具怎么排更均匀」——槽边的判断，还得靠老师傅。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器铺设工、操作员、看护员、金属塑料在岗约 3.17 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.74 万人，岗位净减约 0.43 万个，年均产生约 0.25 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.16 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 和自动化不会立刻取代电镀设备操作工，但会改变工作方式。全自动电镀线、自动加药、AI 浓度监控正在接走重复操作环节，操作工从「手动挂件调参」转向「配槽工艺、质量判断、设备维护」。镀层质量判断和配槽经验，是机器替代不了的核心——懂工艺的老师傅反而更吃香。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于零风险。自动化确实会减少纯操作岗，但配槽、质量判断和工艺调整依然靠人。真正该担心的是「只会挂件下槽」，懂配槽、会调工艺的技师更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选表面处理、化工或机电专业，考安全相关证书。环保意识要强，别去没资质的小作坊。
把自动电镀线、AI 浓度监控和镀层检测学起来，主动学配槽和工艺。从「操作工」升级为「电镀技师」，考取工艺相关证书。
有化工或机电背景最好，可从挂件工或学徒切入。简历上多写「会哪些镀种、配过什么槽、处理过什么质量问题」。
招操作工别只看能吃苦，要看化学基础和守规矩。愿意学配槽工艺、懂环保的员工，值得培养成技术骨干。

ai_s7_trends: 全自动电镀线与 AI 浓度监控普及，操作工从「手动挂件调参」转向「配槽工艺、质量判断、设备维护」，工艺能力成为核心竞争力。
环保政策趋严淘汰落后产能，行业向自动化与集中化发展，高端电镀（电子、汽车）技师更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace pump operators, but it will reduce single-position staffing in the field. DCS/SCADA and predictive maintenance move routine monitoring into central control rooms, shifting operators from watching gauges toward startup and shutdown decisions, emergency response, and cross-training. Roles limited to reading and recording gauges face the greatest pressure, while people who understand equipment and handle incidents become more valuable.

Energy optimization recommendations
Intelligent anomaly diagnosis
Intelligent shift scheduling

Startup and shutdown decisions: people assess operating conditions.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 indicates that this occupation has medium AI exposure in operations: systems take over routine monitoring, but on-site judgment and response still leave a clear role for people.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace radiation therapists, but it will reshape their workflows. Tools handle repetitive and structured tasks while people focus on judgment, responsibility, and creativity. Rote execution roles face displacement, while people who understand real situations and make decisions become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use data profiles to accelerate patient or learner assessment in radiation therapy.
Use simulations and scenario exercises to accelerate radiation therapy planning.
Use retrieval tools to verify radiation therapy materials and regulations.
Use collaboration tools to accelerate cross-team coordination in radiation therapy.
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate structured documents and reports related to radiation therapy.
Process and classify repetitive radiation therapy data.
Perform rules-based preliminary screening and scheduling for radiation therapy.
Search radiation therapy knowledge bases and extract key points.
ai_s3_list: Professional judgment and tradeoffs in real radiation therapy settings.
The ability to explain radiation therapy expertise to non-specialists.
Accountability and final review in radiation therapy.
Cross-boundary resource integration and interpersonal coordination in radiation therapy.
Reuse of tacit knowledge from long-term radiation therapy experience.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Turn 5/10 into an advantage: let AI take the repetitive work, and spend your time on real projects, judgment, and people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong radiation therapy fundamentals first and gain experience on real cases.
Connect existing experience to radiation therapy and find a differentiated entry point.
Turn radiation therapy experience into products or management systems to increase leverage.
Use AI to eliminate repetitive radiation therapy work and focus on decisions.

ai_s7_trends: First, collaboration between radiation therapists and AI becomes routine, making tool literacy an entry requirement.

Third, radiation therapy roles evolve toward combinations of professional expertise + management or product skills.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can lay out a training plan clearly, but teachers still need to see when a student's form breaks down and sense changes in the atmosphere, then provide immediate guidance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 15,400 postsecondary recreation and fitness studies teachers were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 15,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 300 jobs, with about 1,100 openings annually and median annual pay of about $75,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary recreation and fitness studies teachers, but it will transform lesson preparation and research efficiency. AI can provide a foundation for slides, literature, and training plans, shifting teachers' time toward classroom interaction, hands-on instruction, and academic judgment. What is truly difficult to replace is their ability to engage a class, provide real-time training guidance, and give students individual attention.
ai_s2_accel: AI movement analysis and exercise assessment
Smart-wearable data supports instruction
AI learning analytics track mastery
Online course and MOOC production
ai_s2_auto: Automatic generation of initial slides and lecture notes
Literature search and review organization
Digital grade and attendance management
Bulk generation of training-plan templates
ai_s3_list: Classroom and field engagement: how to present the same content so students want to practice.
Real-time judgment during practical instruction: immediately spot and correct poor form or unsuitable intensity.
Academic judgment and research oversight: design sound exercise and health studies and test whether conclusions hold.
Teacher-student relationships and educational responsibility: influencing students' career choices is a long-term commitment.
Overall course and program design: connect theory, training, and industry into an educational system.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 indicates that about half of this occupation's time is spent in classrooms and activity spaces, while lesson preparation, literature work, and grade management can be standardized.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure still brings change. AI makes lesson preparation and research more efficient, placing teaching and guidance quality at the center of evaluation. Teachers who merely follow textbooks and use outdated courses face pressure, while those who engage students and lead training are more secure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study physical education, recreational sports, or exercise science, with a master's degree as a foundation and a doctorate as an advantage. Gain teaching-assistant and training experience during university, developing both practical and research capabilities.

Use AI lesson-preparation and movement-analysis tools, and invest the saved time in course innovation and training guidance. Differentiate yourself in digital fitness or exercise rehabilitation instead of relying on traditional lecture notes.

Postsecondary teaching roles evaluate education + teaching work. Prepare a sample-lecture video and course syllabus. Vocational colleges and community sports training organizations also use these skills, so do not focus only on permanent academic positions.

Require teaching demonstrations and practical assessments rather than evaluating only papers. Candidates who teach engagingly, lead training, and connect with industry are more valuable than those who only produce low-quality publications.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Initial syllabus, lecture notes, and PPT drafts

ai_s7_trends: Digital fitness and exercise science converge, making AI movement analysis and data-driven teaching new standards.
Healthy China initiatives and the silver economy expand recreation and sports programs, increasing demand for faculty.
Postsecondary faculty evaluation shifts from quantity toward quality, with stronger emphasis on teaching and industry integration.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年高校休闲与健身研究教师在岗约 1.54 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.57 万人，净增约 0.03 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.11 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.59 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校休闲健身教师，但会改写备课和研究效率。课件、文献、训练计划都能让 AI 打底，教师的时间转向课堂互动、实操指导和学术判断。真正难以替代的，是讲台上的感染力、带训练时的临场指导，以及对学生的个体关注。

在线课程与慕课制作

实操指导的临场判断：动作变形、强度不适，一眼看出、一句点破。

师生关系与育人责任：影响学生的职业选择，是长期的事。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业有一半时间在讲台和场地现场，能被标准化的环节是备课、文献和成绩管理。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：AI 让备课和研究更高效，教学与指导质量成为核心指标。被挤压的是照本宣科、课程陈旧的教师，能互动、能带训练的老师更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读体育教育、休闲体育或运动科学专业，硕士打底、博士加分。大学期间多做助教和带训练的经验，把「会练」和「会研究」两条腿都走起来。
把 AI 备课和运动分析工具用起来，把时间投到课程创新和训练指导上。往数字健身、运动康复方向做差异化，别停留在传统讲义。
高校教学岗看「学历 + 教学作品」：准备试讲视频和课程大纲。职业院校、社会体育培训机构也是同类技能的出口，别只盯着编制。
招教学岗要试讲和实操，而非只看论文。能讲得生动、带得了训练、又懂产业结合的候选人，比只会灌水的更值钱。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace the occupation as a whole, but automation will continue to absorb standard operations. Template machines and automated sewing cells speed up routine stitching, shifting operators from sewing straight seams to machine adjustment for style changes, complex stitching, self-inspection, and equipment care. People who only perform standard operations face displacement, while those who adjust machines and understand quality are better positioned.

Predictive equipment maintenance

ai_s3_list: Machine adjustment for style changes: people provide the feel.

Defect judgment: people provide the eye.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates medium-high exposure in a highly automated manufacturing area. Equipment absorbs standard operations, but people retain an essential role in machine adjustment and quality.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is standard straight-seam sewing, not roles combining machine adjustment + quality. ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin in vocational school and practice machine adjustment and quality inspection. Pure sewing work is shrinking, so learn equipment early.
Advance from sewing seams to machine adjustment + quality inspection. Learn to read process sheets and master multiple operations.
Highlight yield and multi-operation experience, and specify the product categories you have handled. Factories value consistency and speed.
Do not select candidates only for hand speed; assess whether they can adjust machines. People who tend equipment are worth higher piece rates.

ai_s7_trends: Automated cells are spreading, reducing standard operations.
Machine adjustment for style changes and quality inspection create opportunities.
People who tend equipment are in greater demand.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 86,400 veterinarians were employed in 2024, with employment projected to rise to 94,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 8,300 jobs. The occupation generates approximately 3,000 openings annually, and median annual pay was about $125,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace veterinarians, but it will reshape their workflows by assigning repetitive, structured tasks to tools while people focus on judgment, responsibility, and creativity. Formulaic execution faces the greatest pressure, while professionals who understand real situations and make sound decisions become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use data profiles to accelerate judgments about animals and clients.
Use simulations and scenario exercises to accelerate veterinary plan development.
Use retrieval tools to verify veterinary resources and regulations.
Use collaboration tools to accelerate cross-team veterinary coordination.
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate structured veterinary documents and reports.
Process and categorize repetitive veterinary data.
Conduct rules-based preliminary veterinary screening and scheduling.
Search veterinary knowledge bases and extract key points.
ai_s3_list: Professional judgment and tradeoffs in real veterinary situations.
The ability to explain veterinary expertise to nonexperts.
Veterinary accountability and final review.
Cross-boundary resource integration and interpersonal coordination in veterinary work.
Reuse of tacit knowledge from long-term veterinary experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: Scoring rationale: AI can assist veterinarians, but professional judgment and final accountability are difficult to replace, resulting in 5/10 exposure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Turn 5/10 into an advantage: let AI take the repetitive work, and spend your time on real projects, judgment, and people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong veterinary fundamentals and gain experience with real cases.
Connect prior experience to veterinary work and identify a differentiated entry point.
Turn veterinary experience into products or management capabilities to increase leverage.
Use AI to eliminate repetitive veterinary work and focus on decisions.

ai_s7_trends: First, collaboration between veterinarians and AI is becoming routine, making tool literacy a baseline requirement.
Second, high-value veterinary judgment and accountability are becoming scarcer.
Third, veterinary roles are evolving toward combinations of professional expertise and management or product skills.

body: Veterinarians diagnose animal diseases and injuries through visual examination, imaging, and laboratory testing; perform surgery; prescribe medications and vaccinations; and advise owners on husbandry and preventive health management.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能吞掉其他职业的大量重复与可结构化任务，但判断、责任与人际协调仍由人扛；真正被挤掉的是纯执行层。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年兽医在岗约 8.64 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.47 万人，净增约 0.83 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.30 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.55 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代其他职业，但会重塑Veterinarians的作业流：把重复与可结构化任务交给工具，人聚焦判断、责任与创造。真正被挤掉的是照本宣科式执行，会结合真实场景、会决策的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 用数据画像加速Veterinarians的客情/学情判断。
用模拟与沙盘加速Veterinarians的方案推演。
用检索增强Veterinarians的资料与法规查证。
用协作工具加速Veterinarians的跨团队协同。
ai_s2_auto: 自动生成Veterinarians相关的结构化文档与报告。
对Veterinarians的重复性数据处理与归类。
基于规则的Veterinarians初步筛查与排程。
Veterinarians知识库检索与要点提取。
ai_s3_list: 真实Veterinarians场景下的专业判断与权衡。
把Veterinarians专业知识讲给外行听的表达力。
Veterinarians领域的责任承担与终审。
跨边界的Veterinarians资源整合与人际协调。
Veterinarians长期经验的隐性知识复用。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 评分逻辑：Veterinarians可被 AI 辅助，但「专业判断」与「责任终审」难替代，故5/10 曝光。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 把 5/10 变成优势：用 AI 解放重复劳动，把时间花在真实项目、判断与人际上。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 先把Veterinarians基础打牢，积累真实项目。
用既有经验对接Veterinarians，找差异化切口。
把Veterinarians经验产品化/管理化，放大杠杆。
用 AI 解放Veterinarians重复劳动，聚焦决策。

ai_s7_trends: 一是Veterinarians与 AI 协同成为常态，工具素养成门槛。
二是Veterinarians的高价值判断与责任环节更稀缺。
三是Veterinarians岗位向「专业 + 管理/产品」复合演进。
